Hi Leah / Tom —

Thanks again for the time today — appreciate Leah walking through the clinical use case and Tom flagging procurement timing. Quick synthesis from our side and suggested next steps so we keep momentum with the buying committee: 

Key stakeholders I captured (please correct if I missed anyone):
- Economic/financial sponsor: Rachel Park, VP Finance (decision authority on spend) — Leah indicated Rachel will sign off on budget allocation.
- Security/Compliance: Priya Shah, Head of InfoSec (needs SOC 2 + data residency confirmation).
- Procurement: Tom Ramirez (purchase order & contract cadence).
- Product/Platform owner: Dr. Samuel Ortiz, Head of Clinical Data (will evaluate model outputs & acceptance criteria).

Decision criteria we heard on the call:
- Latency and tail latency guarantees for inference (SLO target: <150ms 95th pct for batch of typical requests)
- Cost per 1k tokens and expected monthly spend for pilot vs. GA
- Data residency and auditability (audit logs + KMS integration)
- Quality: pass/fail thresholds on downstream triage accuracy measured by A/B on pilot prompts

Suggested mutual action plan (MAP) / next steps: 
1) Share security artifact pack (SOC 2 summary, encryption/KMS docs) — due: 2026-07-13 — owner: Karthik
2) Tailored pilot scope + success metrics doc — due: 2026-07-14 — owner: Marissa
3) Pricing sketch for a 3-month pilot + estimate for scale — due: 2026-07-14 — owner: Karthik
4) Procurement checklist & legal intake (redlines + standard SOW) — Tom to advise timeline; Redwood to provide standard SOW template — owner: Connor — due: 2026-07-15
5) Kickoff pilot meeting with technical stakeholders (Priya, Dr. Ortiz) — proposed week of 2026-07-20 — owner: Marissa/Connor

Attachments I[0m[0m: Demo-Recording.mp4 (recording of today's demo). I will also attach a short security pack in a follow-up message.

If this aligns, I'll send the formal MAP and drop the security pack in a separate email right after this.

Thanks —
Karthik

Thanks, Karthik — this is helpful and captures the main threads. A couple quick clarifications from our side: 

- Priya (cc'd) will want the SOC 2 Type II report (or SOC 2 summary to start) plus your encryption at rest/in-transit details. Can you include the specific KMS integrations and whether Redwood supports customer-managed keys?
- On procurement: our PO cycle is typically 6-8 weeks once we have the SOW and pricing; Tom, correct me if I'm oversimplifying. We likely need an initial pilot PO or contract addendum to spin up reserved capacity.
- For the pilot scope: Dr. Ortiz wants to run a constrained test (approx. 25k inference/day) across two clinics and measure triage delta vs. baseline over 4 weeks. Success metric = >=5% absolute improvement in triage accuracy (or statistically significant improvement).

Could you also include a redline-friendly SOW and a ballpark pilot price today so Tom has something to escalate to procurement? Finally, we will need to confirm data residency in us-east-1 for the pilot.

Appreciate you moving fast on this.

Best,
Leah
Director of Digital Health | Acme Health Systems

Leah / Priya — quick note from the CS side. I've attached a draft pilot scope (Pilot_Scope_v1.pdf) that aligns with Dr. Ortiz's ask. High level:
- Duration: 4 weeks
- Traffic: ~25k inferences/day across 2 clinic endpoints
- Success metrics: triage accuracy delta >=5% or p<0.05; latency 95th < 150ms; error rate <0.5%
- Deliverables: weekly checkpoints, dashboard access + runbook for on-call during pilot

We'll propose a lightweight integration (S3 ingestion + streaming inference endpoint) and provide a sandbox with US-East-1 residency. If Priya wants to schedule a 30-min technical review for the security checklist, I can set that up for next Tue/Wed.

Marissa
